svg.title: My ninja way
svg.desc: A Java editor window showing Tharinda's daily loop (learn, build, improve) beside three things he builds: full-stack apps, computer-vision AI, and competitive-programming solutions.

g.text: Third-year undergrad who enjoys building practical software.
React and Next.js front ends on Spring Boot and Node.js services
Computer vision and CNN models with OpenCV, TensorFlow and Keras
Competitive programming in C++ and Java, one contest at a time
“Stand your ground. Keep coding, keep growing.”
